sections.title: 19. Glossary & Acronyms

claims.text: **Activity** — Android entry-point component; owns a window and hosts Fragments / Views.
**Capability BRD** — Synthetix artifact: 17-section v2 document describing what the legacy system does — feature catalog, FR24/FR25/FR26/FR27/FR28/FR29/FR30 claims, traceability.
**Composable** — A Kotlin function annotated with @Composable that emits Jetpack Compose UI nodes.
**Dagger** — Compile-time dependency-injection framework for Java/Kotlin. Generates graph code at build time.
**Fragment** — Android UI component that represents a portion of a screen; hosted inside an Activity.
**Gradle** — Build automation system used by Android projects; configured via Groovy or Kotlin DSL scripts.
**Koin** — Pragmatic lightweight dependency-injection framework for Kotlin. Uses a DSL to declare modules — no code generation.
**LiveData** — Observable data holder that respects the Android lifecycle; superseded by StateFlow in newer codebases.
**Migration BRD** — Synthetix artifact: 13-section v2 document describing how to migrate — constraints, ADRs, module sequencing, NFRs, runtime operations.
**Moshi** — JSON (de)serialisation library for Kotlin/Java — compile-time codegen, null-safe adapters.
**MotionLayout** — Android layout type that animates between ConstraintSet states via an XML-declared transition.
**OkHttp** — HTTP client library Retrofit layers on top of. Handles connection pooling, interceptors, HTTP/2.
**Retrofit** — Square's type-safe HTTP client for the JVM and Android. Maps an annotated Kotlin/Java interface to REST API calls.
**StateFlow** — Kotlin Flow variant that carries the latest state and emits it to new subscribers.
**Symbol Index** — Synthetix data structure listing every class / function / endpoint discovered in the repo, with canonical IDs, modules, and source-file anchors.
**Trust Envelope** — Synthetix gate output declaring whether the artifact is consumable (PASS/WARN/BLOCKED) and which downstream agents are allowed to read it.
**ViewModel** — Android lifecycle-aware holder of UI state that survives configuration changes.
**ViewPager2** — Android widget that enables swipeable paged UIs; replaces ViewPager with RecyclerView-backed internals.
